meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 对代码库做一次“技术债体检”:它会从 9 个方面(架构、一致性、类型、测试、依赖、性能、错误处理、安全、文档)扫描代码,找出问题并标出具体文件和行号,最后生成一份 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告,按严重程度排序并估算修复时间。
howto.when: 当用户提到“tech debt”、“code health”等关键词,或要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、架构审查等任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个仓库的技术债,输出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md。
say.note: 将触发一次 9 维度扫描并生成报告。

say.text: 检查代码健康度,重点看架构和测试。
say.note: 会对架构和测试维度做深度审计。

say.text: 列出代码里最需要优先修复的技术债。
say.note: 会按影响/工作量排序给出 Top 5。

howto.what_en: Claude performs a 9-dimension technical debt audit, citing file:line for each issue, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user mentions keywords like 'tech debt' or 'code health', or asks for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, or cleanup planning.

say_en.text: Audit this repo's tech debt and output TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md.
Check code health, focusing on architecture and tests.
List the top technical debt items to fix first.
